verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's own product page states it has apps for mobile, desktop and web and that 'Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.' This is backed by end-to-end encrypted cloud backups, and a community user confirms using the desktop app. Missing for 10: detailed help documentation on how sync works (timing, conflicts, automatic propagation), explicit mention of tablets, and independent hands-on confirmation of real-time multi-device sync.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Auth has an app for every platform. Mobile, desktop and web. Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.
Auth provides end-to-end encrypted cloud backups so you don't have to worry about losing your tokens.
Ente Auth is awesome - I've been using it ever since Authy discontinued their desktop app.
